title: English File Pre-Intermediate, File 10 (check against the book)

fixIt.text: She opened the door and walked in the room.
This temple was build in the 12th century.
Rice is grow in many provinces.
Angkor Wat was builded in the twelfth century.
fixIt.explain: build is irregular: build, built, built. Passive: was + past participle.

fixIt.text: These shirts are make in Cambodia.
English is speak in many countries.
fixIt.explain: Passive: is + past participle. speak, spoke, spoken.

fixIt.text: My phone was stole on the bus.
fixIt.explain: Passive: was + past participle. steal, stole, stolen.

fixIt.text: The rice is grown by farmers in the countryside, and it is sell in the market.
This song was wrote by a Cambodian singer.
fixIt.explain: Passive: was + past participle. write, wrote, written.

fixIt.text: The letters are deliver every morning.
Many old buildings were destroy in the war.

fixIt.explain: You go up or down stairs; along is for a road or a river.

fixIt.text: The bus went under the tunnel.
fixIt.explain: through = in one side and out of the other.

fixIt.text: He got out the tuk-tuk and paid the driver.
fixIt.explain: get out of a car, taxi or tuk-tuk; get off a bus, bike or moto.

fixIt.text: Walk past the market and turn on the left.
fixIt.explain: turn left, or turn to the left.

fixIt.text: Please turn on the TV. I want to sleep.
fixIt.explain: To stop a machine: turn it off.

fixIt.text: I need to look after a word in the dictionary.
fixIt.explain: look up a word = find it in a dictionary. look after = take care of.

fixIt.text: Please put off your shoes before you go into the temple.
fixIt.explain: take off clothes or shoes; put on is the opposite.

fixIt.text: I gave on smoking last year.
fixIt.explain: give up = stop doing something for good.

builder.tip: With it, the pronoun goes in the middle: turn it off.

builder.text: This bag was made in Cambodia.
The temple was built by the king.
builder.tip: Passive with by: who did it.
take off = remove clothes or shoes.
across = from one side to the other.

builder.text: English is spoken all over the world.

radio.title: The silk island
radio.text: Last Sunday we took a boat across the Mekong to Koh Dach, a small island near Phnom Penh. Silk is made there in the traditional way. The cloth is woven by hand on wooden machines under the houses. A woman showed us how the silk is dyed with colours from plants. We walked along the river, and then we got back on the boat before the rain started. I bought a scarf for my mother. It was made by the woman we met.
